name: 谋关平

officialSkillText.mou:wuwei: 出牌阶段限一次，你可将一种颜色的所有手牌当【杀】使用（无次数距离限制），其中每有一种牌类型你可选择一项执行一次：1.摸一张牌；2.目标角色本回合非锁定技能失效；3.此技能本回合可发动次数+1。若此【杀】执行了所有选项，则伤害+1。

sourceAgreement: The current general page and the formal release announcement provide the same complete Wuwei text.

userAdjudications.decision: 同一次武威允许重复选择同项；总选择次数不超过本次实际材料的基本牌、锦囊牌、装备牌类型数。
userAdjudications.provenance: Explicit user answer relayed by coordinating agent on 2026-10-21; this is a project adjudication, not an official FAQ.

implementation: Use all current Hand cards of exactly one actual color through native UseSelectedCardsAs. Different suits of the same color are included; no suit equivalence is invented.

Freeze the real native Use material types. Ordinary and delayed tricks share the trick type. Follow an immutable option cursor on the owning native trigger frame; repeated choices consume the same frozen budget.
The native Slash has its own quota and distance exemption. Ordinary Slash uses receive no exemption.
Each Play phase has its base use; option 3 adds remaining uses for the actual current turn. Extra-use tokens are consumed across inserted Play phases without duplication.

Draw uses the native draw producer and typed return. Suppression uses the native current-turn non-locked skill suppression mechanism. Executing all three distinct options gives only this original Slash damage +1.
